source.stem:
A compound of element X has the formula X₂O and a relative formula mass of 144.

What is element X?

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Comets show long tails throughout their orbits.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: All asteroids orbit between Mars and Jupiter.

intelligence.enrichment: Asteroids are small rocky, irregular Solar System objects, many of which revolve around the Sun between Mars and Jupiter; comets are objects made of dust, gases, rocks, and ice that can show long tails as they approach close to the Sun. Rocky irregular bodies without the comet tail pattern are classified as asteroids, while icy-dusty bodies that develop long tails near the Sun are classified as comets. The learner correctly applies this rule: Asteroids are small rocky, irregular Solar System objects, many of which revolve around the Sun between Mars and Jupiter; comets are objects made of dust, gases, rocks, and ice that can show long tails as they approach close to the Sun. All small objects in the Solar System are comets if they move around the Sun.
